amendment: Protocol/evidence bug repair before any model training. Pilot outcomes retained; no trial deletion or best-result replacement.

bounded_repairs.allowed: Exact construction/runtime API repair only without threshold relaxation; physical parameter changes require distinct config hash and three new gates. Preserve initial failures.

g1_reset_randomization.deployment_input: randomization seed, scene and node metadata are evaluation-only, never model features
g1_reset_randomization.evidence: record actual additive robot offsets, applied full node velocity array and SHA256, node IDs and injection simulation time
g1_reset_randomization.node_rule: one initial post-reset injection before first physical step; all attachment vertices exactly zero
g1_reset_randomization.purpose: repair previously ineffective G1 seed variation; ranges fixed before revised primary runs; not outcome tuning
g1_reset_randomization.robot_reference: add to existing frozen robot reset center; same seed means same robot draws for hands and paired variants

physics_apparatus_revision.contact_evidence: triangle proximity within85mm probe-center box AND induced mesh displacement>20mm AND bounded applied force>.05N, or 3D wall proximity
physics_apparatus_revision.force_frame: current body frame explicitly converted each physics step

physics_gate_reuse: Exact scene physical hash, three gate seeds and original summaries unchanged; existing gate free-node velocity amplitude .002m/s exceeds revised G1 .001m/s. Robot reset perturbations require new EMPTY controls, not a claim of material validation.
primary_admission: Only revised _rng1 trials with explicit seeded reset and complete sampled actual-collider body/cloth audit may supply supervised P/B. Unsupported audit remains UNKNOWN or physics-invalid; no truth model inputs.

prior_pilots.reason: G1 seeds did not explicitly randomize state; old G1 lacks synchronized body collider poses/nonpenetration evidence. Preserve raw labels as historical diagnostics, exclude from primary metrics.

revision_reason: DR family metadata corrected to DR_COMBINATION (physical hash unchanged); apparatus frame-conversion defect repaired before G1; v1 first diagnostic preserved. Contact evidence proximity is explicitly proxy, strict penetration unchanged.
